meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把新版本发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果发布了新版本后需要确认它真正上线了
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version to npm and confirm the release succeeded
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a new version and verify it went live

howto.what: 你说要发布时，Claude 会从 dev 分支触发发布流水线，测试通过后发布到 npm，再核对 GitHub 发布、npm 包与 Discord 公告是否完成，并写好发布说明；它只发布，不审查或改代码，流水线失败就报告并停下。
howto.when: 当你说 publish、release、deploy 等发布类词，并给出 patch、minor、major 或具体版本号时接管；没给版本号就先停下询问。

say.text: 帮我做个 patch 版本发布。
say.note: Claude 会走完整发布流程，最后告诉你结果和链接。

say.text: 发布一个 minor 版本，写清楚新功能说明。
say.note: 发布说明会自动写到 GitHub 和 Discord。

say.text: 用 5.0.0-beta.9 发一个预发布版本。
say.note: 按指定版本号执行，不推断、不修改版本号。

howto.what_en: It triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow from dev, waits for CI, verifies npm packages, GitHub release and Discord post, and writes the release summary. Ship-only: no code review or fix during publish; on failure, reports and stops.
howto.when_en: It triggers when the user asks to publish/release/deploy with a version selector (patch, minor, major, or explicit semver); without one, it stops and asks.

say_en.text: Do a patch release for me.
say_en.note: Runs the full publish flow and reports result with links.

say_en.text: Release a minor version and explain the new features clearly.
say_en.note: The summary is written to GitHub and Discord automatically.
Uses that exact semver; nothing is guessed or changed.
